verdict.rationale: Microsoft's docs describe building bots/agents that receive messages and events via the Bot Framework messaging endpoint (quickstart, Slack Bolt port, message streaming, slash commands) and Graph API webhooks/connectors for external services to receive notifications, which together constitute a real-time events API for bots. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a persistent WebSocket/gateway connection (Teams uses HTTPS webhook callbacks rather than a socket-based gateway), and independent/hands-on developer confirmation of real-time reliability.
